WIN a trip to Philadelphia for two with Visit Pennsylvania!

The Philadelphia Eagles are bringing the NFL to Tottenham Hotspur Stadium this October, and this season you could go beyond the game. In partnership with Visit Pennsylvania, we're giving listeners the chance to explore the city behind the team in a once-in-a-lifetime trip.
  • Milly Watson
  • Published: 10:19, 30 Sep 2026
  • Updated: 11:07, 30 Sep 2026
    Add us as preferred source

    For your chance to win fill in this form between the 30th September - 8th October!

    Immerse yourself in one of America's most historic and vibrant cities with a four-night stay in Philadelphia. From iconic landmarks and fascinating museums to colourful neighbourhoods, buzzing food markets and thriving arts and culture, there's something new to discover at every turn. Your included 3-day attraction pass unlocks access to more than 35 of the city's top experiences and tours, giving you the freedom to explore Philadelphia's rich heritage and modern energy at your own pace. Whether you're a history buff, foodie or culture lover, this is the perfect city break.

    The prize package includes:

    • Return flights from mainland UK to Philadelphia, USA
    • Roundtrip airport transfers in Philadelphia
    • 4 nights’ 4* hotel accommodation in Philadelphia, sharing a double occupancy room (check in 20 November, check out 24 November 2026)
    • 3-day all-inclusive attraction pass, granting access to 35+ attractions and tours in Philadelphia
    • A pair of tickets to watch The Eagles take on The Pittsburgh Steelers in Philadelphia on Sunday 22nd November 2026

    How to play if you're selected

    • One contestant will be brought to air everyday Monday 5th – Friday 9th October
    • The contestant has 60 seconds on the clock to answer as many questions as they can about the NFL
    • With each correct answer, they score themselves a TOUCHDOWN
    • They’re allowed to ‘Pass’ on a question if they don’t know the answer, but we can’t go back afterwards, and we can only accept their first answer
    • Contestant with most Touchdowns at the end of the week wins a trip to Pennsylvania and tickets to Philadelphia Eagles

    Don’t miss out - enter NOW. 18+, T&Cs apply. Good luck!

    Prize Terms & Conditions

    The prize package is for two (2) people, all of whom must be available to travel from the 20 to 24 November 2026 with the same itinerary;  At least 1 person travelling must be over the age of 21; where any travellers are aged under 18, they must have prior parental or guardian permission; Economy flights from major mainland UK airports; Flights may be indirect and not all routings will be available; Flight itinerary will be selected by prize provider at their sole discretion; includes cabin luggage only; Additional luggage or prebooked seats may be added but will be payable by the winner and guests; Travel arrangements, including costs relating to public transport, fuel or parking, to and from the winner or companion/s’ home and UK departure airport do not form part of the prize and are the responsibility of the winner and their travelling companion/s; Accommodation is based on two (2) adults sharing one (1) double occupancy room in Philadelphia with check in on the 20 November and check out on the 24 November 2026; Accommodation will be selected by prize provider at their sole discretion; A valid credit or debit card for incidentals may be required to guarantee your room on check in and therefore at least one of the travellers must possess and travel with a valid credit or debit card; The prize excludes travel insurance, domestic ground transfers, meals and drinks, hotel incidentals, excursions, attractions, treatments, visas, personal expenses and anything not expressly stated in the prize package; All elements of the prize are subject to availability; if unavailable, experiences and items of a similar nature and equal monetary value may be offered at the prize provider’s discretion; Winners are responsible for arranging their own travel insurance policy, and for ensuring that this includes insurance cover for the correct destination and for any applicable activities which they will be undertaking while away. The Prize Provider reserves the right to request proof of valid travel insurance prior to travel; Winners must contact prize provider with three preferred travel dates in three separate months no later than six weeks prior to departure; Once booked, the prize cannot be amended or cancelled; Prize is non-refundable and non-transferable; no cash alternative is available; Prize must be taken over the 20 to 24 November 2026, no other dates will be offered, if the winner is unable to travel across these dates they will forfeit the full prize; All travellers will require a passport valid for at least 6 months on date of travel; any necessary visas or additional insurance are the responsibility of the winner and guests; If the winner elects not to, or is unable to, use part of the prize, the winner will forfeit that part of the prize package.

    Specific Competition T&Cs

    Tickets are valid only for the specified game date and cannot be exchanged for an alternative date or event.

    No cash alternative or ticket substitution will be offered.

    Tickets are for personal use only and must not be resold or exchanged for cash.

    The game date and/or time may be subject to change by the NFL or venue.

    Visit PA is not responsible for lost, stolen or damaged tickets.
